label: Box K node projected from the NECESSARY_2 classical GOD_4 root (inference)
rule: Existential elimination and introduction, conjunction elimination, and the definitional identity of NecessaryAt with box-existence (necessaryAt_iff_boxExistsAt, Iff.rfl)
meaning: Assembly (a weakening, not a substantive derivation): for the same signature, Profile m and world w, the witness n of NecessaryClassicalGodRootAt is an actual root (first conjunct of PerfectRootAt); its necessity NecessaryAt m.ontic w n is box-existence of the same n over the same frame m.ontic.frame (Iff.rfl, no bridge); n is GOD_4, is the one GOD_4 (IsTheOneGod, the fourth of the nine case predicates) and has the signature's classical attributes field. So the box K node holds for that n. The relation CN (causes the necessity of) is unconstrained and unused by the box K sense. Uniqueness of the selected root, maximum, perfection, firstness, esse/essence identity, matter/form exclusion, remoteness and the other eight case predicates are discarded; no converse is claimed (see the strictness separator). As an assembly it closes the box K node only if its premise is closed (invariant 16 fixpoint); it does not expand the box K node in the route-cost diagnostic.
